name: 1P-MIPLA
summary: 1P-MiPLA, also known as 1-propanoyl-lysergic acid methylisopropylamide (1-propanoyl-MiPLA), is a designer drug and presumed serotonergic psychedelic of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD). It is the 1-propanoyl derivative of MiPLA and may act as a prodrug of MiPLA. 1P-MiPLA has been discussed on specialized online forums since 2018.
